title: Ladder 16 · Epistulae dē cāseō (letters about a cheese)
summary: Ten letters between two Roman friends: Marcus in noisy Rome begs Lucius for his famous cheese; a procession, a letter carrier who smells of cheese, well-mannered robbers who send a thank-you letter, and a neighbour who guards the cheese by eating it. English → Latin, then the Latin twice. Iulia's voice.
